People around Sam often share different ideas about the office. At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit. On Thursday evenings, Sam reviews the notes from class. Our teacher is very kind.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. In fact, on top of his salary, he gets a travel allowance.

The experience taught Sam more than any book could. The training center has become an important part of daily life. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Cafés face high staff turnover every summer.
